newsitem.title: USA: Logimetrics says merges with mm-Tech.
newsitem.headline: Logimetrics says merges with mm-Tech.

text.p: LogiMetrics Inc said on Friday it completed its acquisition of mm-Tech Inc and the outstanding shares of mm-Tech common stock was converted into an aggregate of 19,247,800 shares of LogiMetrics common stock.
The deal, which made mm-Tech a wholly owned subsidiary of LogiMetrics, is intended to be tax free and will be accounted for as a "pooling of interests," LogiMetrics said in a statement.
It also said that Charles Brand, the founder of mm-Tech, will become chairman and chief executive officer of LogiMetrics, as well as the company's largest shareholder.
Norman Phipps, the current chairman and acting president of LogiMetrics, will remain with the company as president and chief operating officer, the company said.

It added that its board of directors had been reconstituted to consist of Brand, Phipps, Alfred Mendelsohn, Frank Brand and Jean-Francois Carreras. In another announcement, the company said it completed a restructuring of its senior bank facilities with North Fork Bank.

Pursuant to the restructuring, it said, the holder of the company's senior subordinated indebtedness had also agreed to waive some outstanding events of default to provide the company with time to obtain additional financing.

"Now that we have cured the outstanding defaults on substantially all of our existing indebtedness, the company can turn its attention to finalizing its plans to raise additional capital to solidify its capital base and to support the implementation of our growth strategy," said company president Phipps.
LogiMetrics is a manufacturer of high power RF equipment. Recently, the company has been redirecting its focus away from defense applications and toward commercial opportunities.
mm-Tech supplies transmitters and other equipment for the local multipoint distribution service market.
